description: The first-run path as AGSC-02-94 states it after its 1.0.0 amendment: `init` on a bare folder of notes, then the one thing only the publisher can state — `.well-known/security.txt` with a `Contact:` field (AGSC-06-36) — then `ci`, which exits 0 with warnings only (AGSC-02-92): the adopted note has no description (AGSC-E408) and `site.base` is the development placeholder (AGSC-E506). Run with the real verbs, not a schema check of what `init` would write: `after_init` lists the files the publisher adds between the two verbs. Expected values are derived by hand from the rule text. Supersedes adopt-0006.
